items.title: Gartner: Truist says growth rebound looks further away, cuts rating
items.summary: Investing.com -- Truist downgraded Gartner to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $210 from $235 in a note Wednesday, telling clients that a recovery in the research company’s key growth metric now looks less likely in the near term.

items.title: Loyalty Must Leave the Corner Before Agents Rewrite Commerce, Says Epsilon’s Hicks
items.summary: If AI agents end up doing more of the shopping for consumers, the loyalty programs that brands built around apps, inboxes and points balances may need rebuilding within a few years. Gartner predicts 60% of brands will use agentic AI to deliver one-to-one interactions by 2028. Not everyone expects loyalty to survive intact.
